_purpose: Move 85 permitted-change allowlist relative to the adopted Move 84 v07 baseline. check_move85_inherited.py enforces this mechanically against the REAL verified Move 84 v07 ZIP bytes supplied at run time.
_additive_only: Move 85 modifies NO inherited file. modified_paths is empty and the checker fails if it is not. rust/, all schemas, all fixtures, every adopted gate and every adopted document remain byte-identical.
_no_prebuilt_executable: Every Move 85 addition is text. No prebuilt witness-verify executable is packaged; the binary is built by the gate.
_pack_is_a_publication_not_a_source_arti: The audit pack itself is NOT in this list. It is generated by the gate from freshly built binaries and published into MOVE85_OUTPUT_DIR. A pack committed as source would be a claim; a pack generated by a gate run is a measurement.
